title: 子字符串异或查询
summary: 对每个查询 [first,second]，在二进制字符串中找数值等于 first XOR second 的最短子串，平局取最左；不存在返回 [-1,-1]。
insight: 目标最多在 int 位宽内。预处理每个起点至多 30 位的无前导零子串数值，首次出现即是最左；非零值的规范二进制长度唯一，零只需记录单字符零。
pitfalls: 非零答案不能以零开头才可能最短
长度只需枚举至多 30 位

solutions.title: 预计算短二进制子串值
solutions.idea: 把查询转成 target 到区间的哈希查找。
steps: 扫描 start：若 s[start]==0，仅 putIfAbsent(0,[start,start])
否则累计至 min(n,start+30) 的二进制 value，每步 putIfAbsent
对 query 计算 target=first XOR second 并查映射

code.java: class Solution { public int[][] substringXorQueries(String s,int[][] queries){Map<Integer,int[]> positions=new HashMap<>();for(int start=0;start<s.length();start++){if(s.charAt(start)=='0'){positions.putIfAbsent(0,new int[]{start,start});continue;}int value=0;for(int end=start;end<s.length()&&end<start+30;end++){value=(value<<1)+(s.charAt(end)-'0');positions.putIfAbsent(value,new int[]{start,end});}}int[][] answer=new int[queries.length][2];for(int i=0;i<queries.length;i++)answer[i]=positions.getOrDefault(queries[i][0]^queries[i][1],new int[]{-1,-1});return answer;} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun substringXorQueries(s:String,queries:Array<IntArray>):Array<IntArray>{val positions=HashMap<Int,IntArray>();for(start in s.indices){if(s[start]=='0'){positions.putIfAbsent(0,intArrayOf(start,start));continue};var value=0;for(end in start until minOf(s.length,start+30)){value=(value shl 1)+(s[end]-'0');positions.putIfAbsent(value,intArrayOf(start,end))}};return Array(queries.size){positions[queries[it][0] xor queries[it][1]]?:intArrayOf(-1,-1)}} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public:vector<vector<int>> substringXorQueries(string s,vector<vector<int>>& queries){unordered_map<int,vector<int>> positions;for(int start=0;start<(int)s.size();++start){if(s[start]=='0'){if(!positions.count(0))positions[0]={start,start};continue;}int value=0;for(int end=start;end<(int)s.size()&&end<start+30;++end){value=(value<<1)+(s[end]-'0');if(!positions.count(value))positions[value]={start,end};}}vector<vector<int>> answer;for(auto& query:queries){int target=query[0]^query[1];answer.push_back(positions.count(target)?positions[target]:vector<int>{-1,-1});}return answer;} };
